name: redlines-site
description: Documentation site for redlines. Nothing here is imported by the wheel; see ADR-0026.

scripts.api: cd .. && uv run pdoc -o site/api-tmp redlines && rm -rf site/public/api && mv site/api-tmp site/public/api && rm -f site/public/api/index.html
scripts.predev: npm run api && npm run sync
scripts.prebuild: npm run api && npm run sync
